name: @openeventkit/widget-core
description: Framework-free foundation for mounting legacy widgets: the WidgetManifest contract (including the WidgetBridge shape), the createWidgetShadow primitive, the neutral host ports, and the widget-to-host DOM event contracts (auth-error, notify). Imported by both the Next app (reactComponent renderer) and the esbuild web-component build (webComponent renderer).
